quests.title: Animal Research: Frostfin Whales

dialogue.sit: Linnea quickly makes the necessary preparations for the investigation...
(There seems to be something nearby worth examining. <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color>, with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

dialogue.t: There's nothing there...
Seems like today is not our lucky day.
Looks like today's not our lucky day... We've been waiting so long and haven't even spotted a single ordinary Frostfin Whale...
Hmm...
Hmm... Maybe we should call it a day and head back. There'll be other chances.
But... you're only back for a short while before you leave for other places again, right?
Let's wait a bit longer, then.
Wait... Helka, is that you?
Linnea! Yes, I'm back. But my archive isn't quite complete yet, so our showdown will have to wait.
Oh? So the trip was fruitful, then. I haven't been idle either, and I added quite a bit to my own records.
Did you come to see the Frostfin Whale too?
Yes. I heard it was only discovered recently. Considering its size, I suspect environmental changes caused the shift in its skin color.
Like the concentration of kuuvahki in the area, for example...
It's a shame, but we probably won't see it today. We've waited so long, and we've got nothing to show for it.
Linnea... back me up here! Let's just call it a day and head back, Maisie...
I'm fine. I feel better than usual since I woke up this morning. Let's wait a little longer.
I heard that anyone who sees the Frostfin Whale can have their wish come true. So... it's supposed to bring good luck, right?
I hope you can take the luck it brings with you on your next journey, Helka.
But...
Let's wait together, then.
...Linnea!
Don't worry. I have a feeling we're going to see that Frostfin Whale today.
You know how it is, Helka. My instincts are always right.
Alright... then we'll wait a little longer. But just a little, okay?
Look, look! Wow, it jumped so high!
I wish I could swim that fast too... Swimming with them must be so much fun!
Let's just jump in now—
Hey! That's too dangerous! Geez, nothing's changed while I was away. You're still as reckless as ever...
W—What? Don't you want to play with them too? They're having so much fun!
But if your clothes get wet, you might catch a cold. Why not stay on shore and use the Kamera to capture them having fun?
Hmm... makes sense. Then I'll borrow Helka's Kamera for a bit.
That was a great shot!
Feeling satisfied now?
Mhm! Whether the legend's true or not, I hope that, wherever you go, Helka, luck will see you through any danger and bring you back to Speranza, safe and sound.
...Thanks.
Hehe, shall we head back then? Thanks so much, Linnea! See you at Speranza!
Mm-hmm! See you there!

quests.description: It is said that a pink Frostfin Whale has been spotted in the waters northwest of Lempo Isle…
